why_ai: Integration-driven evidence software that AI-native rivals can rebuild, though compliance demand keeps growing.
why_clarity: Controls map to frameworks and audits pass or fail, but real security effect is unmeasured.
why_digital: Cloud integrations, evidence and audit artefacts, sold as SaaS.

why_ai: Causal question about controls and incidents is novel, contested and never measured.
why_clarity: No agreed outcome measure, and incident effects show over years.
why_digital: Control-state data and incident records analysed on screens.

why_ai: Raw configuration data is already collected, so normalisation is a modelling task.
why_clarity: Configurations are observable, but what counts as comparable implementation is undefined.
why_digital: Cloud and identity configurations processed entirely in software.

why_ai: Continuous evidence collection through integrations is automation already largely realised.
why_clarity: Each control check runs the same way continuously with pass or fail results.
why_digital: API integrations collecting evidence for audit artefacts.

why_ai: Crosswalks are a semantic problem over stable texts that language models handle well.
why_clarity: Framework texts are fixed, and mappings can be reviewed against auditor acceptance.
why_digital: Framework documents and control sets mapped on screens.

why_ai: Joining incidents to controls depends on governed data access from insurers and regulators.
why_clarity: Incident data is partial and biased, so linkage results cannot be checked.
why_digital: Data work, but access rests on negotiated insurer and regulator relationships.

why_ai: Versioning, distribution and attestation are mechanical, and AI drafts policies directly.
why_clarity: Required policies, annual reviews and attestations form a checkable list.
why_digital: Document library and attestations managed online.

why_ai: Answering questionnaires is retrieval over a stable answer corpus.
why_clarity: Hundreds of near-identical questions per buyer, answered from a known library.
why_digital: Spreadsheets in, answers out, exchanged remotely in sales cycles.

why_ai: Coordination automates, but persuading engineering without authority needs a person.
why_clarity: Audits give checkpoints, but juggling four frameworks and teams varies week to week.
why_digital: Dashboards and spreadsheets, coordinating internal teams.

why_ai: Residual screenshots and confirmations are requests that automation can contextualise and shrink.
why_clarity: Each evidence ticket has a defined ask and an audit deadline.
why_digital: Tickets and system screenshots handled on screens.

why_ai: Collection, tiering and monitoring of suppliers are mechanical at scale.
why_clarity: Assessments repeat across hundreds of suppliers, but whether they reduce risk is unknown.
why_digital: Questionnaires and certificates exchanged with suppliers online.
